Drive Deluxe 3 Wheel Rollator doesn't live up to description

The Drive Deluxe 3 Wheel Rollator has such a great list of features, it is a crying shame it misses the target implementing a basic, sturdy basket. Please take the time to incorporate these suggestions into your next product release and I'm sure you will sell millions. Height adjustments: 31"-38" - recommend these sockets adjust from 32" to 41" to better enable an operating height from 5'7" through 6'4".. Current height forces a large part of the public to lean over to reach the handles, thereby promoting poor posture.

Includes basket, tray, and pouch (THE BASKET IS POORLY ENGINEERED. It feels flimsy enough to disconnect and dump any cargo when you hit any type of sidewalk hazard. The stability of the tray is negatively impacted by the basket. Most trays would include at least one cup holder. Not this tray. However, the pouch works very well.

Lightweight aluminum frame - This is accurate and helps make it portable. Major advantage over other 3 and 4 wheel units. Large 8" wheels for indoor and outdoor use. 10" wheels would be preferrable for Internal aluminum cast loop-lock brakes - work as advertised.

Easy folding for transport and storage - because the basket design and instructions don't clarify how to fasten the basket securely. It will actually disconnect and dump anything that takes up more than 60% of the space. Once you get the basket off the rollator it can be folded, carried, and stored easily. Since it does so well on these features, it's a shame the basket is such a poor design.

## About Drive Deluxe Folding 3 Wheel Rollator, Blue, Aluminum Frame

The Drive Deluxe Folding 3 Wheel Rollator is ideal for those who need a little help getting around. With its height-adjustable handlebars and 7.5 inch front swivel caster, it's easy to control and steer. Plus, the foldable wire basket and tote bag make it easy to transport your belongings. The tray on top of the basket keeps important items, food and beverages within reach. And the handle brakes and rear wheel locks make it easy to stop and start. The quick and easy folding action makes it easy to store away when not in use. Plus, the lock button keeps the frame secure when it's unfolded. The Drive Deluxe 3 Wheel Aluminum Rollator supports a maximum weight of 300 pounds.

### Key Benefits & Features

- The height-adjustable handlebars and 7.5 inch front swivel caster provides easy control and steering.
- Store items in the foldable wire basket or the tote bag for convenient transport.
- A tray sits on top of the basket to keep important items, food and beverages within each.
- Handle brakes and rear wheel locks bring the drive Deluxe 3 wheel aluminum rollator to a stop.
- A quick and easy folding action converts the lightweight aluminum frame to a compact size.
- A lock button keeps the frame secure when it's unfolded.
- The blue drive rollator with basket supports a maximum weight of 300 pounds.

Is a three-wheel rollator stable enough for outdoor use?

It rolls on pavement and sidewalks, but three wheels give less support than four. It is best on smooth, level ground and indoors.

Does it have a seat?

No. This model has no seat, so it is for walking support only. A four-wheel rollator is the better choice if you need to rest.

The rollator, a basket, a tray and a pouch.

How does it compare with a four-wheel rollator?

It is lighter and turns more easily in tight spaces, but it lacks a seat and is less stable. Choose it for portability, not for resting.
